notes: Pseudonyms are assigned afresh for every event and every run - data from two events or two runs cannot be joined on author_id.
The sampling rule is identical for every day of the window, baseline days included.

Bluesky search matches whole words, so every inflected form is searched separately; keywords = groups whose search found the post, text_keywords = groups whose forms appear in the post text. An empty text_keywords usually means the word was in a link, link preview or image alt text.

Each query ran over the whole window and, if it had more than window_pages pages, again day by day; truncated_keyword_days lists the (query, day) pairs that still hit the page cap and may be incomplete.
createdAt is set by the client and can be unreliable; comments dated before their material are excluded (reason: comment_before_material).
Bluesky search does not guarantee complete results and the API may truncate very large threads - compare reported_replies with fetched_comments.
Bluesky's reach in Poland before late 2024 was small.
